articles.summary: The testing is part of the TCCO Technology Roadmap Program, managed by MxV Rail under the Association of American Railroads, introducing Rail Vision's AI-powered perception technology to Class I railroads. Ra’anana, Israel, Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rail Vision Ltd.
articles.title: Rail Vision Selected for U.S. Rail Industry Testing Program, Advancing AI-Powered Technology from Roadmap to Real-World Evaluation
